name: shubhmilan-astrology-kb
embeddingText: feature_key + qualifier + text_en (the string embedded for each chunk; see scripts/ingest-astrology.ts)

chunkSchema.category: one of: ashtakoot | doshas | muhurta | remedies | nakshatras
chunkSchema.feature_key: canonical feature, e.g. nadi_koot, mangal_dosha, vivah_muhurta
chunkSchema.qualifier: observed variation, e.g. dosha | cancelled | high_score (or null)
chunkSchema.source: attribution string surfaced to the user

userSources.note: Drop Jyotish texts (.md/.txt/.json) here. The ingestion script normalizes them into the chunkSchema above before embedding. Curated files above are always ingested; sources/ is additive.
